name: app-lime-and-black-ride-hailing-screens
title: Autonomous ride app in electric lime and black
whatItIs: A case-study board with two big rounded panels: a lime one with 'The future of urban mobility — available in one tap' and a phone with a dark map and a 'Where to?' sheet; a black one with a phone whose lime screen shows a van arriving, a countdown chip and buttons. Below are a small vehicle render and a dark map tile with a lime route.
whatItMeans: Futuristic, precise and confident; the lime on black feels like a high-vis signal.
techniques: Use a single neon lime as the only colour with black, white and grey.
Swap the whole screen colour between states (dark map vs lime arrival).
Use a dark, low-detail map so the lime route line is the hero.
Float a black chip over the phone to enlarge a key number (2:47).
Give big rounded bottom sheets and pill buttons a soft feel.
bestFor: Brands wanting a techy, energetic identity

vocabulary.definition: A very bright colour used sparingly on a dark base.
A panel sliding up from the bottom of the screen.
A small info card breaking outside the phone frame.
A highlighted path on a map.
